mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_key AS permission FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.perm_id = p.id WHERE u.id = 1 AND p.perm_key IS NOT NULL
